faq: How much does a restaurant or café design project cost?
From $30 per m², minimum project budget $2 500. We give the exact price after the brief and a site visit.
What does a venue design project include?
Concept, layout of dining room, bar and kitchen, 3D visualisations, working drawings, materials and furniture specification, renovation estimate.
Can you renovate and furnish the venue?
Yes, with our own team. Furniture, lighting and decor can be brought directly from China. If we do the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.
